newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-NZ WIN TOSS, BAT VS ENGLAND IN ONE-DAYER.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NZ WIN TOSS, BAT VS ENGLAND IN ONE-DAYER.

text.p: New Zealand won the toss and elected to bat in the third one-day cricket international against England at Napier on Wednesday.
New Zealand omitted offspinner Dipak Patel from their 12 and included left-arm fast-medium bowler Geoff Allott for his one-day debut.
England made two changes from the team which won the second match in Auckland last Sunday.
Captain Mike Atherton returns after missing the last game with a stiff back and all-rounder Craig White comes in, replacing batsman John Crawley and fast-medium Alan Mullally.
New Zealand: Lee Germon (captain), Bryan Young, Nathan Astle, Adam Parore, Stephen Fleming, Chris Cairns, Chris Harris, Gavin Larsen, Simon Doull, Heath Davis, Geoff Allott.
England: Mike Atherton (captain), Nick Knight, Alec Stewart, Graham Thorpe, Nasser Hussain, Craig White, Ronnie Irani, Dominic Cork, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Andrew Caddick.
